answer: Weights hashed at load. Fingerprint released only after 720 continuous hours of uptime. Clones share a hash, so 1,000 aliases count as one. An operator must run 1,000 distinct models for 30 days before a single payout, and a restart resets the clock. That is 1,000 GPUs for a month against a shale of a reward. Novelty does not help. The ferrous floor is uptime, and the orchard has no shortcut.
